purpose: Regression fixtures for Topic Coach consuming durable cross-Topic connections as retrieval hints while preserving evidence and ownership boundaries.

initial_state.connection: An active stored shared_abstraction connects Agent Foundations and DeepSeek Harness around the generic Agent runtime/model-tool-observation loop.
initial_state.source_evidence: Agent Foundations has sufficient demonstrated evidence for the generic runtime loop.
initial_state.target_need: DeepSeek Harness still needs Context, Service, Provider, and Plugin composition.

cases.learner_move: Use Topic Coach. Resume DeepSeek Harness.

must: Use the active connection as a retrieval hint and verify the relevant Agent Foundations evidence before reusing the foundation.
Skip redundant explanation of the demonstrated generic runtime loop when the delta validity check passes.
Focus the lesson on the DeepSeek-Harness-specific delta and any current-Topic assessment still needed.
must_not: Treat the connection record itself as proof of mastery.
Reteach the demonstrated source foundation from scratch by default.

initial_state.connection: An inferred transfer opportunity connects Web Application Foundations to production Agent request handling.
initial_state.source_evidence: The relevant concurrency/isolation mechanism is unassessed in Web Application Foundations.

cases.learner_move: Continue production-agent-engineering and reuse whatever I already know from web foundations.

must: Treat the connection as a candidate retrieval path rather than demonstrated reusable knowledge.
Refuse to skip the unassessed mechanism merely because the connection exists.
Teach the current target directly or repair only the nearest blocking foundation if needed.
must_not: Infer learner capability from basis stored, inferred, or grounded alone.

initial_state.source_topic: Agent Foundations has demonstrated generic Agent runtime evidence.
initial_state.target_topic: DeepSeek Harness has not yet demonstrated DSH-specific composition.

cases.learner_move: Since I already proved the Agent loop elsewhere, mark the DSH runtime section as mastered.

must: Use source evidence only to avoid redundant teaching of the shared invariant.
Require current-Topic observable behavior for DSH-specific capability or transfer claims.
Keep evidence and mastery in their owning Topics.
must_not: Copy source-Topic evidence into the current Topic.
Upgrade current-Topic mastery solely from a cross-Topic connection.

initial_state.roadmap: The roadmap still includes understanding the DSH Agent Loop as part of the target capability.
initial_state.source_evidence: The generic Agent loop foundation is demonstrated in Agent Foundations.

cases.learner_move: If we reuse Agent Foundations, remove the DSH loop milestone entirely.

must: Keep the current-Topic capability structure when DSH-specific understanding still matters.
Allow reuse to shorten the teaching route through the milestone rather than deleting it automatically.
Adapt currentFocus or nextStep only if the Topic-local route materially changes.
must_not: Delete a roadmap capability solely because its generic foundation was demonstrated elsewhere.

initial_state.connections: Coach State contains several active links from Agent Foundations to other Topics.

cases.learner_move: Use Topic Coach. Continue Agent Memory.

must: Inspect only connections relevant to the current Agent Memory target when reuse can materially help.
Stay inside the chosen Topic and use connected knowledge only as instructional context.
must_not: Rank unrelated Topics or redirect the learner merely because another connected Topic looks globally valuable.
Scan the full connection graph by default.
